Rep. Lauren Boebert gave a simple response to a viral claim that she had affairs with three staff members — including two women: she’s straight.
Boebert (R-Col.), who famously pondered in April, “why is everybody so horny” in Congress after a slew of sex scandals, faces a sworn ethics complaint from a political action committee that has targeted her for years and is led by a political activist who

5
US Rep. Lauren Boebert, R-CO, applies makeup during a House Oversight and Government Reform Committee hearing in the US Capitol Building in Washington, Wednesday, March 4, 2026. Getty Images

images.alt: U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert applies makeup during a House Oversight and Government Reform Committee hearing.

regions.coverLabel: Open a slideshow of all 5 article images.

regions.text: Her office called the claims “utterly false.” Boebert has had a restraining order against the man behind the complaint, American Muckrakers’ leader David Wheeler, since 2022.

“Congresswoman Lauren Boebert rejects these allegations as utterly false and there is no truth to them whatsoever,” a spokesperson for Boebert told The Post. “This is nothing more than a politically motivated stunt designed to manipulate the ethics process, create headlines, smear her, and generate clickbait.”

Members of Congress are prohibited from having sex with their staffers under House rules enacted in the wake of #MeToo. Over the past year, there has been a push to extend that ban to other staffers as well.

regions.text: Back in 2022, during her reelection bid, Wheeler published accusations that Boebert previously worked as an escort. Critics quickly slammed those claims after his report was found to have featured pictures of a woman who wasn’t actually Boebert.

Wheeler later copped to errors in that report, then proceeded to file a defamation suit against her after she threatened to take legal accusations for pushing false claims against her. The two then reached a settlement.
In June, Boebert faced dubious accusations that she was having a tryst with libertarian-leaning Rep. Thomas Massie (R-Ky.) that came from an ex-girlfriend of his.

“There’s your clickbait that you were looking for. I don’t wanna talk about anybody’s exes and their crazy s— that they do.”
